# Extra Python dependencies for DynaNav and Isaac Sim workflows.
# Install with: "${ISAAC_SIM_PYTHON}" -m pip install -r requirements-test.txt
# Isaac Sim 5.0 ships binary modules compiled against the NumPy 1.x ABI.
# Keep NumPy below 2 and do not install requirements-train.txt here, because it
# can replace Isaac's CUDA/PyTorch stack.

transformers>=4.40.0,<5.0.0
huggingface-hub>=0.34.0,<1.0
accelerate>=0.20.0
einops>=0.7.0
timm>=0.9.12
opencv-python>=4.8.0
matplotlib>=3.7.0
PyYAML>=6.0
